[LSCP.1.5] **An author scope is one of four values.** The `scope_value` of
[LGRA.5.1]'s `schema_lifecycle`, whose productions are the grammar's, is
`explicit`, `activation`, `logical`, or `ttl` with a duration; `logical` and
`ttl` may carry the `ambient` modifier ([LSCP.1.7]). The set is closed: no
other value is an author scope.
